text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - Spike in 5xx and gateway timeouts observed from us-west-2 edgepool (starts 2351122330). Alerting on >8% 5xx over 1m and latency 95p > 1.2s. Auto-escalation to oncall.

ashley.eng: seeing automatic failover fires in the dashboard, lots of 502/504s from proxy layer. Anyone oncall for us-west?

jordan.sre: I'm oncall, joining. Looking at edgepool metrics now. Can someone paste the recent deploys?

miguel.ops: no deploys to gateway in last 30m. There was a routing config rollout 14m ago on the edge ingress controller (flag: "use-new-conn-throttle").

jordan.sre: good catch. pulling controller rollout history. If it's config, we should hit rollback now.

ashley.eng: impact: approx 12% of requests to us-west are 5xx, customers in west seeing errors and increased latencies. CS flagged two customers. Need notify.

rebecca.support: I'll open a customer notify draft. Short note: "We're investigating elevated errors in the west region; routing mitigations in progress".

jordan.sre: running quick curl checks to origin via edge gateway and direct to backend.

```
# from onboard jumpbox
curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null https://gw-us-west.redwood.ai/healthz
# and
curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null https://backend-01.us-west.internal/healthz
```

jordan.sre: gw health returns 200 but slow. Backend direct is 200 and fast -> suggests proxy/egress layer or connection pooling issue.

miguel.ops: looking at egress pool stats: us-west egress pool exhaustion spikes aligned with errors. Some AZs show high active connections. Might be uneven load distribution.

ashley.eng: can we shift traffic away from affected AZs/region? We have routing override API. Suggest progressive shift 30% -> 60% -> 100% to us-east until stable.

jordan.sre: agreed. I'll apply a routing steer to send 40% to us-east for now. Command:

```
# admin CLI
rbctl routes set-steer --from-region us-west-2 --to-region us-east-1 --percent 40 --reason "mitigate egress exhaust"
```

jordan.sre: applied 40% steer. monitoring.

incident-bot: Audit: route-steer applied by jordan.sre at 2351122440.

ashley.eng: monitoring metrics show 5xx dropping to ~6% after steer. Keep increasing if stable.

jordan.sre: ramp to 70% now.

```
rbctl routes set-steer --from-region us-west-2 --to-region us-east-1 --percent 70
```

miguel.ops: also temporarily disabled the new conn-throttle config on ingress controller in us-west. Patch applied.

jordan.sre: after both actions 5xx back down to 1.5% and p95 latency improved. Still seeing sporadic tail errors from a subset of edge replicas.

ashley.eng: note for postmortem: investigate load balancer connection distribution and why conn-throttle rollout caused uneven exhaustion.

rebecca.support: customer notify updated and sent to affected accounts. CS rep will follow up.

jordan.sre: handing off to miguel for deeper root cause and long-lived mitigation. I'll stay on standby during handoff. Miguel, can you own the bridge?

miguel.ops: taking over. I'll collect logs, run haproxy stats, and schedule an autoscale bump for edgepool to relieve pressure while we root cause.

miguel.ops: commands I'm running now:

```
haproxyctl stats --pool edge-us-west --interval 5s
kubectl -n gateway rollout undo deploy/edge-ingress --to-revision=$(rollout-before-1)
edgepoolctl scale --pool us-west-primary --replicas +3
```

miguel.ops: rollback confirmed, autoscale bump in progress. HAProxy shows a small set of nodes with rising queue length -> connection leak suspect. Opening ticket to replace those nodes once drained.

deploy-bot: Deprecated config "use-new-conn-throttle" removed from canary pools in us-west at 2351122698.

jordan.sre: good. I'll prep an alert tweak to avoid noisy paging while we stabilize (lower noise threshold and add longer evaluation window).

rebecca.support: CS asked for ETA on full recovery and root cause. We can say: "mitigations applied, traffic steered to alternate region, rollback done, error rates trending to normal. Investigating connection distribution; updates every 30m."

sam.sales: flagged a strategic customer on a paid SLA. Asking for direct contact. Who will own exec comms?

ashley.eng: I'll take exec comms with support. cc @rebecca.support and @jordan.sre.

miguel.ops: current state at 2351123050: 5xx at 1.2% in us-west, p95 latency ~420ms. Edgepool replicas being rotated to replace the two bad nodes. Routing steer still at 70% -- will gradually reduce after healthy nodes back.

jordan.sre: creating incident-1234 ticket and assigning to eng-runtime and infra. Postmortem owner: ashley.eng. Runbook link: internal://runbooks/egress-exhaustion.

rebecca.support: adding customer notes and ticket refs. Will close customer notify loop after postmortem draft.

ashley.eng: thanks everyone. We'll keep this thread open until we reduce steer back to normal and finish postmortem.

miguel.ops: oncall handoff to rebecca in 40m for monitoring, I'll remain reachable for followups.

incident-bot: Incident 2351122330 marked as mitigated (partial) at 2351123050. Next: postmortem and RCA. :white_check_mark:
